purpose: Challenge the selected within-stock half-session amount-clock repeatability mechanism against every nearby frozen family before any Campaign049 value is computed.
numbering_disambiguation: Historical Campaign049 is separate from prospective Candidate49 and does not activate or backfill that ledger.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A repeatable within-stock liquidity clock across the two continuous half sessions is consistent with stable participation and execution capacity rather than one-off activity bursts, potentially leaving a more resilient completed-session state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: Use exactly 120 morning amounts and 120 afternoon amounts. Normalize each half independently to p_i=a_morning_i/sum(a_morning) and q_i=a_afternoon_i/sum(a_afternoon). With m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2, return 1-[0.5*sum(p_i*log(p_i/m_i))+0.5*sum(q_i*log(q_i/m_i))]/log(2), using 0*log(0/m)=0.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.distance: equal-mixture Jensen-Shannon divergence converted to similarity

overlap_challenges.reason: Participation entropy asks whether full-day amount is concentrated or diffuse. Campaign049 normalizes each half separately and asks whether the two 120-bin clock shapes match; two halves can have identical entropy but different clock locations and low similarity.
Serial persistence compares adjacent amount positions. Campaign049 compares equal clock positions 120 bars apart and contains no lag-one pair or autocorrelation.

Those factors measure directional timing or late-session mass. Campaign049 removes each half's total scale and rewards repeatability regardless of whether the common profile is early-, middle-, or late-peaked.
Market synchronization compares a stock with a leave-in or leave-one-out market activity profile. Campaign049 is entirely within-stock and does not load a market benchmark.

The estimator geometry is deliberately the same fixed equal-mixture JSD, but the economic object is different: terminal Campaign040 compares high-low volatility allocation, while Campaign049 reads amount only and compares liquidity-participation scheduling. Reusing a frozen estimator does not substitute the source mechanism; the all-factor statistical gate remains mandatory.

Those factors pair activity with returns, volatility, direction, range, transaction price, or leads/lags. Campaign049 reads no price field and computes no contemporaneous or lagged cross-field relation.
Campaign049 never divides amount by volume, constructs VWAP, reads Candidate49 values during construction, or interprets transaction prices.
Campaign049 reads no open, high, low, or close and has no wick, range, body, gap, frontier, return, or path statistic.
Campaign049 contains one raw amount statistic and no terminal factor value, fitted weight, filter, threshold, regime, subset, combination, or model.
